snippet.title: Boxing Machine VR | Announce Trailer 2
snippet.description:
🥊 Boxing Machine VR is now live on Steam and Meta!
Enter a gritty steampunk gym and face off against robotic boxers in two intense VR modes: Rhythm & Sparring.
Built for full immersion. Packed with action.
